findings.text: A group scoped reclaim service is provided that accepts a target group and requested page count with allocation flags and option bits plus an optional swappiness control and reports how many pages were freed using a zonelist centered on the current node.
A pressure notification helper is provided that ignores priorities above a critical threshold and otherwise forwards a critical signal for the given allocation flags and group.

A soft limit reclaim service is provided that handles order zero requests on one node by scanning overage groups and reports reclaimed pages while accumulating scanned pages through an output parameter.
A hierarchy walker is provided that enumerates descendant groups under a root with optional shared reclaim coordination and manages lifetime references across successive steps.
A single node shrink service for one group is provided that allows writeback and unmapping with swapping controlled by a flag and reports reclaimed and scanned progress.
Invocation installs per task reclaim state around the core attempt with begin and end tracing while suppressing nested reclaim allocation and clears the task state before returning.
Invocation expects caller installed reclaim state with diagnostic on absence and emits soft limit begin and end tracing around vector shrinking while returning reclaimed pages and scanned count.
Group scoped versus global mode is distinguished by presence of a target group in one build variant while another build variant always reports global mode.
Root scope is recognized when no target group is set or the target is the root group in one variant while another variant always reports root scope.
Task reclaim state has single ownership with diagnostics on overwrite of a live pointer and on clearing an already empty slot while the assignment still proceeds.
Excess over soft limit equals current memory usage minus configured soft limit when usage is larger and zero otherwise.
Overage groups are ordered in a tree keyed by excess amount with a cached rightmost pointer to the largest entry and a flag preventing duplicate insertion plus cache maintenance on removal.

Group reclaim starts at a default priority with full zone coverage and ensures the requested amount meets a cluster sized floor while write and unmap are permitted and swap and proactive behavior follow option bits.

Zone iteration visits each backing node once per pass and restores the original allocation mask after temporary widening for buffer head pressure while considering throttling once when any node was visited.

At default priority direct reclaim outside group scope and outside the background reclaimer continues beyond the initial goal while group and background paths enforce balance between anonymous and file families once the goal is met.
Iteration advances through descendants while holding a read section and acquires a reference for non root entries while releasing the previous entry except when it is the supplied root.
Selection insertion and removal on the per node overage tree occur with the tree irq saving lock held except for an initial lockless emptiness test treated as best effort.
Hierarchy traversal is protected by a read side critical section with atomic generation and position updates coordinating concurrent reclaim walkers.

Reclaim control carries request sizing and progress accounting plus allocation flags and zone ceiling plus target group and priority plus permission toggles for write unmap and swap plus node filter plus order plus retry state for full walk forced deactivation and low reserve handling plus congestion and compaction signals.

Per group per node state carries an on tree flag plus cached excess plus tree linkage plus back pointer to the group while the per node tree header carries a root plus rightmost cache plus irq saving lock.

Shared walk state comprises a per root per node iterator with monotonic generation and current position plus a per walker cookie with node context and joined generation used to detect completion by a peer.

Core reclaim descends priority while scanning zones until goal or compaction readiness then snapshots faults and clears congestion per node and on no progress retries in order with full hierarchy walk then forced deactivation then low reserve inclusion before reporting failure with distinct success and compaction abort returns.

Soft limit handling repeatedly extracts the largest overage group on the node and reclaims from it then reinserts the entry by current excess until some progress occurs or no candidate remains or a bounded loop count is exceeded.

Targeted soft reclaim walks descendants of an overage root accumulating per victim results and stops when root excess disappears or after two empty passes or once progress reaches a quarter of starting excess or a loop bound is exceeded.

Vector shrinking obtains per class scan budgets and drains them in bounded batches until classes empty then after meeting the goal halts the smaller of anonymous versus file families and scales remaining budgets toward proportionality with a final active anonymous rebalance when aging is allowed and inactive is low.
Misuse of task reclaim state is only diagnosed with one time warnings while still performing the overwrite or clear so callers must ensure balanced install and removal.

Global buffer head pressure temporarily elevates the reclaim mask to include high memory and raises the zone ceiling with restoration afterwards so concurrent accounting must tolerate transient promotion.
Concurrent walkers race on shared position with atomic compare exchange retry and a newcomer joining at the end restarts to observe at least one group while stale generation causes early exit.
Soft limit decisions use lockless emptiness and usage reads plus retry on vanished excess or failed reference acquisition so selection may be skipped or repeated under concurrency.
A symbolic cluster amount defines the minimum reclaim request size and the per victim target and the per list batch size.
Symbolic defaults define the starting reclaim priority and the highest zone index for full coverage plus a costly order threshold gating compaction readiness checks.
